narrative.intro: Reed Technology and Information Services reported $218M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Reed Technology and Information Services won 1 award so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $218M, and obligations are up 27.0% year over year. Annual obligations show a sequence across fiscal years: FY21 $175M, FY22 $185M, FY23 $198M, FY24 $199M, FY25 $172M, FY26 $218M. Reed Technology and Information Services' current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). The concentration of obligations in FY2026 reflects the single large award counted in the current period. Procurement officers and primes tracking Reed Technology and Information Services should note the recent uptick in obligations and the firm’s year-to-date position relative to the prior five fiscal years. The data do not include a breakdown by agency, by product or service, or by expiring-contract dates in the summary figures provided here.
